title: ありがとうの贈りもの
subject_en: Thank-you gifts and gestures, each a separate object, kawaii soft style with warm pastel colours Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white.
lead: 花束、肩たたき、手紙、お茶。勤労感謝の日や敬老の日、日ごろの「ありがとう」を伝える12点。
items: a hand-tied bouquet with a ribbon
a letter with a heart seal on a blank envelope
a tea cup with a small sweet on a plate
a small bear tapping the shoulder of a larger bear
a gift box tied with a ribbon
a large pink heart wrapped in a ribbon
a blank card with a flower and a small heart
a basket of assorted cookies and candies
two hands holding a small heart
a round cake with a single strawberry
a cat bowing politely with a flower
a bear holding a flower bouquet and smiling
